model_provenance: the joint model, its exact Fp2/rank algebra and its included/excluded observation classes are Claude Fable 5.1's FA7 work (scripts/zk60_fable_joint_capture.py, scripts/zk60_fable_joint_rank.py), imported unchanged; only the parser and the recomputed repaired layout are Opus 5's.

manifest.note: published validation record, status 'complete'; its own source_commit is the head the validation ran at, capture_source_commit is the captures' implementation pin

included_observation_classes.group_vectors: every message coordinate v_g[j], j < n, of every group vector (2 base rows each)
included_observation_classes.proximity_vector: every coordinate prox[j], j < n (2 base rows each)
included_observation_classes.terminals: every claim value (2 base rows each), including the H sum claim's public value 0
included_observation_classes.zero_sum: H only: the public constraint sum_j u[j] = 0 on the zero-sum mask row pair (2 base rows), proven by the zsum sumcheck
included_observation_classes.aliasing: one unknown per (row, column): rows opened by several claims are the same unknowns

excluded_observation_classes.pads: the Q pad coordinates v_g[n..n+Q) of every clear vector: linear in the Q fresh pad unknowns of each row, not in the message unknowns (FA2 section 14.6 argument; not modelled)
excluded_observation_classes.sampled_columns: the Q opened encoded columns (values, salts, paths): (f_row + Z_n g_pad) at coset points, hidden by the pads (Vandermonde) and the salted leaves (hash assumption); not modelled
excluded_observation_classes.cfs: the CFS mask commitment and the masked sumcheck round messages / claimed sums: nonlinear in the data; FA6
excluded_observation_classes.repeats: repeated proofs of the same witness (fresh challenges each): FA8; every capture is analysed alone
excluded_observation_classes.unopened_columns: the Merkle root over unopened columns: computational hiding assumption, outside a linear model

structure_validated_only.pads: width and count only (every clear vector has exactly n + Q entries); the pad VALUES stay outside the linear model
structure_validated_only.sampled_columns: count, index range, per-column value width, salt width and Merkle path length only; the column VALUES stay outside the linear model

limits: A linear-model rank result on four fresh-PoC captures under the captured (fixed) public coefficients. It is not a simulator, not a conditioning argument and not an upper bound on disclosure.

Excluded by construction and unchanged from FA7: pad coordinates, sampled encoded columns, the CFS mask commitment and masked sumcheck round messages, repeated proofs of one witness, and the Merkle root over unopened columns. Each needs its own argument.

This is NOT whole-protocol zero knowledge. It covers only the experimental ffn-v3-mr1-fresh-poc/1 profile at T32/d16/f16, function 1, with fresh per-proof weights: no registered/seamed profile, no function 2, no stable private model identity, no attention, no wire decoder, no transport envelope.
The captures hold no witness values; nothing here is compared to a ground truth.
No private-block, deployment or throughput acceptance follows.
